title: Analog/mixed-signal chip (IHP SG13G2, full chip)
description: JKU's IHP SG13G2 chip template: a counter (digital) and an inverter (analog) macro in a 32-pad padframe with a seal ring. Full chip builds the pads, logos and macros, assembles the chip with LibreLane and checks it; the rest of the template (IO cells, layouts, scripts) comes with the IIC-OSIC-TOOLS image.
